questions.text: Why do the animal studies fail to settle whether animals appreciate music?
options: A Animal hearing differs entirely from human hearing.
B The experiments have tested too narrow a kind of music.
D Animals cannot participate spontaneously in experiments.

questions.text: Which topic best describes the passage as a whole?
options: A Connections between language and psychology
C The place of music in human life

groups.text: Choose the best answer, A, B, C or D, for each question.
